definitions.charge_normalized_count: absolute charge divided by maximum absolute truth charge (a charge-mass unit, not a universal vortex count)
definitions.component_count: number of connected estimator components/accepted records; raw winding uses same-sign components
definitions.joint_success: zero location-count error, absolute-charge error, and signed-charge error
definitions.location_count: number of estimated location records; raw winding uses same-sign connected components as its location proxy
definitions.winding_cell_count: number of nonzero plaquette winding cells; zero means not applicable for contour/Jacobian records
